ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_watermark interrupt (status type, default 1): raised if the transmit FIFO is past the high-water mark.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_watermark interrupt behavior with a clear trigger condition: raised when transmit FIFO past its high-water mark.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_watermark interrupt (status type): raised if the receive FIFO is past the high-water mark.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_watermark interrupt behavior with a clear trigger condition: raised when receive FIFO past high-water mark.

ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_done interrupt: raised if the transmit FIFO has emptied and no transmit is ongoing.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_done interrupt behavior: raised when transmit FIFO empty and no ongoing transmission.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_overflow interrupt: raised if the receive FIFO has overflowed.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_overflow interrupt behavior: raised on receive FIFO overflow.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_frame_err interrupt: raised if a framing error has been detected on receive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_frame_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected receive framing error.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_break_err interrupt: raised if break condition has been detected on receive.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_break_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected break condition during receive.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_timeout interrupt: raised if RX FIFO has characters remaining in the FIFO without being retrieved for the programmed time period.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_timeout interrupt behavior: raised when RX FIFO has data not retrieved within programmed timeout.

ref_atoms.ref_content: rx_parity_err interrupt: raised if the receiver has detected a parity error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies rx_parity_err interrupt behavior: raised on detected receiver parity error.

ref_atoms.ref_content: tx_empty interrupt (status type, default 1): raised if the transmit FIFO is empty.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies tx_empty interrupt behavior: raised when transmit FIFO is empty.

ref_atoms.ref_content: fatal_fault alert: triggered when a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault is detected.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies fatal_fault alert trigger condition: detection of a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.PARITY: The UART can be configured so that it sends (or expects) a parity bit after each 8 data bits. In receive mode, the UART sends the rx_parity_err interrupt if it receives a parity bit of the wrong polarity. The parity mode is configurable (ensuring words are even or odd).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes configurable parity generation/checking and rx_parity_err interrupt on wrong polarity, providing concrete hardware behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.LINE_LOOPBACK: The UART can be configured so that incoming bits are sent on the TX side.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies line loopback behavior: incoming bits forwarded to TX, a concrete hardware path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.SYSTEM_LOOPBACK: The UART can be configured so that outgoing bits are registered as having been received on the RX side.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies system loopback behavior: outgoing bits treated as received on RX, a concrete hardware loopback path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.BAUD_RATE_CONTROL: The UART baud rate can be configured.

Feature UART.LINE_BREAK: The UART can detect line breaks (defined as the RX pin being continuously low for several bit-times). The threshold for number of low bits to signal a line break is configurable.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines line break detection (RX pin low for several bit-times) with configurable low-bit threshold, a concrete hardware detection mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Feature UART.FIFO_INTERRUPTS: The UART can be configured to send a 'watermark' interrupt when RX or TX FIFO is nearly full/empty, respectively. It sends an rx_overflow interrupt if it sees an extra character when the RX FIFO is full.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes watermark interrupts for RX/TX FIFO nearly full/empty and rx_overflow on full RX FIFO, providing concrete interrupt generation conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: lsio_trigger signal (uni, req): Self-clearing status trigger for the DMA. Set when RX or TX FIFOs are past their configured watermarks matching watermark interrupt behaviour.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines lsio_trigger as a self-clearing DMA trigger set when FIFOs pass watermarks, matching watermark interrupt behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: racl_policies signal (uni, rcv): Incoming RACL policy vector from a racl_ctrl instance. The policy selection vector (parameter) selects the policy for each register.
racl_error signal (uni, req, width 1): RACL error log information of this module.
BUS.INTEGRITY countermeasure: End-to-end bus integrity scheme.

Register CTRL [rw]: Controls UART operation. Fields: TX (bit0 TX enable), RX (bit1 RX enable), NF (bit2 RX noise filter enable: if enabled, RX line goes through 3-tap repetition code, ignores single IP clock period noise), SLPBK (bit4 System loopback enable: if on, outgoing bits to TX are received through RX; TX line goes 1), LLPBK (bit5 Line loopback enable: if on, incoming bits are forwarded to TX; internal design sees RX value as 1 always), PARITY_EN (bit6 enable parity in both RX and TX), PARITY_ODD (bit7 parity type: 1 odd, 0 even, when PARITY_EN is true), RXBLVL (bits9:8 trigger level for RX break detection: sets number of character times line must be low to detect a break, values 0=2, 1=4, 2=8, 3=16 characters), NCO (bits31:16 BAUD clock rate control).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: CTRL register defines multiple control functions with explicit bit fields and concrete hardware behaviors (noise filter, loopback modes, parity, break detection levels, baud rate).

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register STATUS [ro]: UART live status. Fields: TXFULL (bit0 TX buffer is full), RXFULL (bit1 RX buffer is full), TXEMPTY (bit2 TX FIFO is empty, reset 1), TXIDLE (bit3 TX FIFO empty and all bits transmitted, reset 1), RXIDLE (bit4 RX is idle, reset 1), RXEMPTY (bit5 RX FIFO is empty, reset 1).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: STATUS register provides real-time FIFO and activity status indicators (full, empty, idle) with defined hardware semantics and reset values.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register FIFO_CTRL [rw]: UART FIFO control. Fields: RXRST (bit0 write 1 resets RX FIFO, read returns 0), TXRST (bit1 write 1 resets TX FIFO, read returns 0), RXILVL (bits4:2 trigger level for RX interrupts: if FIFO depth >= setting, raises rx_watermark; values 0=1,1=2,2=4,3=8,4=16,5=32,6=62 characters), TXILVL (bits7:5 trigger level for TX interrupts: if FIFO depth < setting, raises tx_watermark; values 0=1,1=2,2=4,3=8,4=16 characters).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: FIFO_CTRL register controls FIFO reset (write-1-to-reset) and programmable interrupt watermarks with explicit trigger rules for RX and TX FIFOs.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register OVRD [rw]: TX pin override control. Fields: TXEN (bit0 enable TX pin override control), TXVAL (bit1 write to set the value of the TX pin).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: OVRD register provides a TX pin override mechanism with enable and direct value control, a concrete hardware override function.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Register TIMEOUT_CTRL [rw]: UART RX timeout control. Fields: VAL (bits23:0 RX timeout value in UART bit times), EN (bit31 enable RX timeout feature).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: TIMEOUT_CTRL register enables RX timeout and sets the timeout value in bit times, defining a concrete hardware timeout mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: UART smoke test with few bytes transmitted and received asynchronously and in parallel with scoreboard checks. TX and RX have 2 independent threads respectively: program one Tx item in register and wait for it to complete at uart interface, before send another one; sequencally send one Rx byte, then immediately read from register and check it.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes explicit UART TX/RX operations: programming a Tx item in a register, waiting for interface completion, and sequentially reading back a received byte, targeting concrete hardware behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Basic sequence that is extended by most of random sequence. TX and RX have 2 independent threads respectively. TX: keep programming csr wdata with random delay when fifo isn't full. RX: 2 processes. One is to send item through uart interface when fifo isn't full and the other is to read csr rdata when fifo isn't empty.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies TX/RX thread interactions with explicit CSR signals (wdata, rdata) and fifo-full/empty conditions, forming a concrete verification scenario.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Send / receive bytes with parity and odd parity enabled randomly.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Directly tests the UART parity hardware feature with random enabling of odd parity, a specific configurable mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Enable parity and randomly set even/odd parity. Inject parity error randomly on data sent from rx and ensure the interrupt is raised.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies parity error injection and the associated interrupt assertion, targeting a precise error detection mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Program random tx/rx fifo watermark level and keep sending random tx/rx data to fifo. As the number of pending data entries in the tx/rx fifo reaches the programmed watermark level (fifo size >= watermark level), ensure that the watermark interrupt is asserted. Ensure interrupt stays asserted until cleared as well as fifo level dropped. The tx/rx watermark interrupt is sticky.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the programmable watermark level and the sticky watermark interrupt, a concrete hardware feature with detailed assertion/deassertion behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Send over 32 bytes of data but stop when fifo is full.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Targets the specific fifo full condition and its effect on data flow, a well-defined hardware boundary case.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Keep sending over 32 bytes of data over tx/rx fifo. Ensure excess data bytes are dropped and check overflow interrupt. This uart_fifo_overflow_vseq is extent from uart_fifo_full_vseq and override the constraint to be able to send data over fifo size.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Explicitly tests the overflow condition, dropping of excess data, and the overflow interrupt, a specific error-handling mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Fill up the tx/rx fifo. After a random number of bytes shows up on fifo, reset the fifo and ensure that the remaining data bytes do not show up. This sequence is extent from uart_fifo_overflow_vseq, so it can also reset when fifo is at any level, including full or overflow.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Tests the fifo reset behavior at various levels, verifying that pending data is discarded, a precise hardware reset scenario.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Inject frame error in parity and non-parity cases by not setting stop bit = 1. Ensure the interrupt gets asserted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Targets frame error injection via stop bit violation and the resulting interrupt, a specific error detection path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Program random number of break detection characters. Create a frame error scenario and send random number of 0 bytes. If that random number exceeds the programmed break characters, ensure that the break_err interrupt is asserted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies the break detection mechanism with a programmable threshold and the break_err interrupt, a concrete error condition.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Program timeout_ctrl register to randomize the timeout. Send random number of data over rx. Wait until it's about to timeout, then check timeout interrupt doesn't fire. Wait for timeout and check timeout interrupt fires. Wait until it's about to timeout, then use either read csr rdata or send RX item through uart interface to reset timeout timer in order to ensure timeout never fires.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes detailed timeout control register programming, interrupt assertion/suppression, and timer reset via CSR read or RX activity, a precise hardware mechanism.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Run fifo_full_vseq with very small delays.
Enable system looback, then drive uart TX and data will be loopbacked through RX. After loopback is done, uart.RDATA will be equal to the data programmed to uart.WDATA.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Tests the system loopback path with explicit data comparison between uart.TX/RX and the WDAT/RDATA registers, a specific hardware data path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Enable line loopback and drive uart_rx with random data and random delay. Check uart_tx has same value as uart_rx. There is not synchronizer register between uart_rx and uart_tx during line loopback.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies the line loopback mode where uart_rx directly drives uart_tx without a synchronizer, a specific hardware connection.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Use 16x fast clk to sample it, data on uart_rx need to be stable for 3 clocks, otherwise, data change won't be taken. Enable noise filter and drive many glitches. Each glitch doesn't lasts less than 3 clocks. Ensure the noise will be filterred out and it doesn't affect next normal transaction.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Targets the noise filter with a precise 16x fast clock sampling and 3-clock stability requirement, describing glitch rejection behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Start bit should last for at least half baud clock, otherwise, it will be dropped. It's always enabled. Drive start bit for less than half cycle. Ensure the start bit will be dropped.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the always-on start bit filter with a half-baud-clock duration requirement, a specific hardware filter rule.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Enable override control and use register programming to drive uart output directly.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Tests the override control feature that allows direct register-driven manipulation of the UART output, a specific alternate control path.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Use 16x baud clock to sample uart rx. Drive uart rx with 16 bits value, using 16x baud clock. Read RX oversampled value and ensure it's same as driven value.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Verifies the RX oversampling mechanism with a 16x baud clock, comparing the captured oversampled value against the driven bit pattern.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Reduce delay to fill TX fifo and read RX fifo to ensure back2back transfers. Use long back2back transfer to ensure clock difference won't be accumulated across transactions. Uart monitor checks the clock offset between sender and receiver is never over 1/4 of the period.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes back-to-back transfer stress with a monitor that checks clock offset < 1/4 period, targeting timing integrity across continuous transfers.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Combine above sequences in one test to run sequentially, except csr sequence and uart_rx_oversample_vseq (requires zero_delays). Randomly add reset between each sequence.

The TX/RX serial lines are high when idle. Data starts with a START bit (high idle state deasserts, 1-->0) followed by 8 data bits. The least significant bit is sent first. If the parity feature is turned on then an odd or even parity bit follows after the data bits. Finally a STOP (1) bit completes one byte of data transfer.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes specific signal behaviour of tx and rx lines with START, data, parity, STOP bit timing; verifiable against waveforms.

ref_atoms.ref_content: A write to WDATA enqueues a data byte into the 32 byte deep write FIFO, which triggers the transmit module to start UART TX serial data transfer.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Involves WDATA register write triggering TX module start.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The TX module dequeues the byte from the FIFO and shifts it bit by bit out to the UART TX pin on positive edges of the baud clock.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies TX pin behaviour with baud clock edge.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If TX is not enabled, written DATA into FIFO will be stacked up and sent out when TX is enabled.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Behaviour of TX enable gating FIFO data transmission.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The RX module oversamples the RX input pin at 16x the requested baud clock. When the input is detected low the receiver will check half a bit-time later (i.e. 8 cycles of the oversample clock) that the line is still low before detecting the START bit. If the line has returned high the glitch is ignored.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes RX oversampling and START bit detection with glitch filtering.

ref_atoms.ref_content: After it detects the START bit, the RX module samples at the center of each bit-time and gathers incoming serial bits into a character buffer. If the STOP bit is detected as high and the optional parity bit is correct the data byte is pushed into a 32 byte deep RX FIFO. The data can be read out by reading RDATA register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies RX sampling, STOP/parity check, and push to RX FIFO, with RDATA readout.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The logic creates a x16 tick when the NCO counter overflows.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Directly describes NCO counter overflow generating baud tick.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If the TX FIFO level becomes smaller than the TX water mark level (configurable via FIFO_CTRL.TXILVL), the tx_watermark interrupt is raised. The watermark interrupts and the empty interrupt are level-based status interrupts: they stay asserted as long as the FIFO levels violate the configured level, cannot be cleared by writing to the status register, and start off in an asserted state (reset high).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Involves specific interrupt signal and FIFO_CTRL register, with clear, reset-high behaviour.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If the TX FIFO is empty, the tx_empty interrupt is raised. The empty interrupt is level-based: it stays asserted as long as FIFO empty, cannot be cleared by writing to the status register, and starts off asserted (reset high).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific interrupt and level-based persistent until empty condition clears.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If the RX FIFO level becomes greater than or equal to RX water mark level (configurable via FIFO_CTRL.RXILVL), the rx_watermark interrupt is raised. The watermark interrupts are level-based: they stay asserted as long as the FIFO levels violate the configured level and cannot be cleared by writing to the status register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Involves rx_watermark interrupt and RXILVL configuration.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If TX FIFO becomes empty as part of transmit, the interrupt tx_done is asserted once the final byte has been transmitted. The transmitted contents may be garbage at this point as old FIFO contents will likely be transmitted. This is separate from the TX FIFO water mark interrupt.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific interrupt tx_done triggered on final byte transmission, note about garbage data.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If RX FIFO receives an additional write request when its FIFO is full, the interrupt rx_overflow is asserted and the character is dropped.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific overflow interrupt with character drop behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The rx_break_err interrupt is triggered if a break condition has been detected. A break condition is defined as the RX pin being continuously low for more than a programmable number of character-times (via CTRL.RXBLVL, either 2, 4, 8, or 16). Only one interrupt is generated per break -- the line must return high for at least half a bit-time before an additional break interrupt is generated. The current break status can be read from STATUS.BREAK. If STATUS.BREAK is set but INTR_STATE.BREAK is clear then the line break is still going on but interrupt has been cleared. If STATUS.BREAK is clear but INTR_STATE.BREAK is set then there has been a line break for which software has not cleared the interrupt but the line is now back to normal. Frame errors will continue to be reported after a break error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specific break interrupt, detection condition, one-shot until line high, STATUS/INTR state behavior.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The rx_frame_err interrupt is triggered if the RX module receives the START bit (0) and data bits but did not detect the STOP bit (1). In a real frame error the stop bit will be present just at an incorrect time. The start of a line break matches a frame error with all data bits zero and one frame error interrupt will be raised. If the line stays zero until the break error occurs, the frame error will be set at every char-time. Frame errors will continue to be reported after a break error. The effects of the line being low for certain periods: <10 bit-times: Frame Err if STOP=0; 10 with parity: No; 10 no parity: Yes; 11 to RXBLVL*char: Yes; >RXBLVL*char: Frame error every char-time, break at RXBLVL.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Frame error interrupt triggered on missing STOP bit, includes relationship with line break and table summary.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The rx_timeout interrupt is triggered when the RX FIFO has data sitting in it without software reading it for a programmable number of bit times (programmable via TIMEOUT_CTRL). The timeout counter is reset whenever the FIFO depth is changed or an rx_timeout event occurs. If the RX FIFO is full and a new character is received, it won't reset the timeout value. The actual timeout time can vary based on reset of the timer and start of transaction.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Timeout interrupt with counter reset conditions, effects of FIFO full.

ref_atoms.ref_content: The rx_parity_err interrupt is triggered if parity is enabled and the RX parity bit does not match the expected polarity as programmed in CTRL.PARITY_ODD.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Parity error interrupt based on PARITY_ODD configuration.
